title: 3D printer
prompt: a desktop FDM 3D printer: load filament, heat the bed and nozzle, start a print and watch a small part grow layer by layer, remove it; see-through shows the stepper motors, belts, lead screw, extruder gears, hotend, heated bed and mainboard
blurb: Feed filament through a heated nozzle and watch a desktop printer build a chess pawn layer by layer.
